kxrke01.title: Who takes being left on read the hardest
kxrke01.caption:
One read receipt, twelve completely different breakdowns. Pisces wrote a poem about it.
Stay for the twist at the end. Where are you on the board?

kxrke02.title: Who asks “what are we?” first
kxrke02.caption:
Somebody has to ask “so what are we?” Aries asked at the door on date one.
Who in your life would schedule the talk for Q1?

kxrke03.title: Who gives great advice and never takes it
kxrke03.caption:
The group chat's best advice-giver, live: says “rest!” and colour-codes the rest.
Which advice do you give everyone but yourself?

kxrke04.title: Who misses their ex the most at 2 a.m.
kxrke04.caption:
2 a.m., the ex crosses your mind, and every sign handles it very differently. Capricorn has been asleep since ten.
Which one are you tonight?

kxrke05.title: Who makes the first move
kxrke05.caption:
Scorpio is waiting for a sign. Literally a sign. Aries already asked them out twice.
Are you a first-move person or a forty-drafts person?

kxrke06.title: Who’s the best at being single
kxrke06.caption:
Single season, ranked, all the way up to a solo trip through three cities. Grandma asks the big question at the end.
Which spot on the board is yours?
